name: DrivingBench
description: A benchmark where general-purpose vision-language models must drive a real car (Toyota Corolla) around a parking lot cone course at low speeds using three control tools (camera frames, steering, velocity) under real-time latency constraints.

metrics.name: Course Completion Rate
metrics.definition: Percentage of the parking lot cone course completed without human safety intervention or failure.

inference_environment.description: Real Toyota Corolla vehicle driving at low speeds in a parking lot cone course using camera frames and vendor-native harnesses (Codex, Claude Code, Cursor) under real-time latency constraints.

test_method: Models receive camera frames from a Toyota Corolla and directly command steering and velocity around a parking lot cone course at low speeds with up to three attempts per conversation.
notes: Inference latency is part of the task as the car continues moving while the model thinks and new commands replace currently running ones.
